title: 80 deer became 600: the Zion cougar mystery #Shorts
description:
Fewer than eighty deer became six hundred. Two Oregon State ecologists argue that when crowds pushed the cougars out of Zion Canyon in the nineteen thirties, the deer boomed. Between nineteen thirty-eight and nineteen forty-seven, the Park Service killed or removed seven hundred and eighty of them. And the deer ate the young cottonwoods. In nearby North Creek, where cougars stayed, the researchers found almost forty times more young trees. It's a debated idea.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU
